headline: Panthers RT Taylor Moton Out ‘For A While’ With Fractured Fibula
summary: Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton suffered a fractured fibula in Sunday’s 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers that will sideline him “for a while,” head coach Dave Canales said after the game (via Joe Person of The Athletic). headline: Raiders' Kubiak on switching to QB Mendoza: 'We're thinking about everything'
summary: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said the team is thinking about everything, including turning to QB Fernando Mendoza, amid a four-game losing streak.

headline: NFL, NFLPA Working Towards Investigation Over Jalen Hurts’ Treatment
summary: Following the diagnosis that determined Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts would miss the remainder of the season with a deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli, the NFL Players Association called into question the actions the league had taken before clearing Philadelphia of any wrongdoing. headline: Lions beat Packers 20-17 on last-play field goal to bail out Dan Campbell's failed 4th-down gamble
summary: — Dan Campbell's latest gamble did not pan out and the Detroit Lions made plays in all three phases — with some yellow flags that went their way — to bail out the aggressive coach.

headline: For first time in NFL history, all teams in two divisions are above .500 through Week 7
summary: The AFC North and NFC North are loaded, to an unprecedented extent in NFL history.

headline: Vikings rally to reach 6-0 even as offense hits historic lows for unbeaten team
summary: As his offense continued to grind Sunday at historically low levels for an undefeated team, Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell had a simple message: "We're not far off."
